articles.summary: Financial Professional website recognized for innovation Jackson National Life Insurance Company ® (Jackson ® ), the main operating subsidiary of Jackson Financial Inc. 1 (NYSE: JXN), has been recognized by Datos Insights with a 2026 Insurance Technology Impact Award for its dedicated website for financial professionals . articles.title: Jackson Wins Datos Insights Insurance Technology Impact Award
